correctness.rationale: The twelve rhombic facets from the inequalities give exactly fourteen vertices (six axial, eight cube) and twenty-four cube-to-axial edges. A generic plane intersects precisely the edges with opposite endpoint signs. After sign/permutation symmetry of weighted normal m_i=s_i u_i, the three positive weights produce either 8 crossings if m_max>sum others or 6 otherwise; no other generic side count. Each dominant-coordinate event is a triangular spherical cone with rays e_i, (s_j/s_i)e_i+e_j, (s_k/s_i)e_i+e_k. Evaluated the standard determinant/dot-product solid-angle formula: each cone angle is 2 arctan e^(-q_i), and eight octants give 4/pi sum_i arctan e^(-q_i). Taylor expansion Q(x)=asinh(e^x), F(y)=arctan(e^-y) gives positive transverse Hessian and the claimed coefficient. Independently enumerated 24 edges, checked 20,000 Gaussian normals over four stretches against the exact 6/8 criterion and frequency formula; compared the one-axis t=100 asymptotic coefficient. These corroborate the analytic proof.
